name: filebeam
description: End-to-end encrypted file and note sharing by Vented.

scripts.build: npm run check:icons && npm run build:encryption && npm run build:transfer && npm run build --workspace=backend
scripts.check: npm run check:icons && npm run check:themes && npm run check --workspace=backend && vp check ui/src tests/browser tests/theme scripts/og scripts/prism-gallery playwright.config.ts playwright.theme.config.ts vite.config.ts && npm run types:check --workspace=backend && vue-tsc --project scripts/og/tsconfig.json && vue-tsc --project scripts/prism-gallery/tsconfig.json
scripts.format: npm run check:fix --workspace=backend && vp check --fix ui/src tests/browser tests/theme scripts/og scripts/prism-gallery playwright.config.ts playwright.theme.config.ts vite.config.ts
scripts.test:transfer: scripts/cli/run.sh bash -ceu 'cargo test --manifest-path crates/transfer/Cargo.toml --locked && cargo test --manifest-path crates/transfer-native/Cargo.toml --locked && cargo test --manifest-path crates/transfer-wasm/Cargo.toml --locked'
